name: Garlic powder
description: Dehydrated ground garlic — convenient, and quite unlike the fresh clove.

nutrition.highlight: not the same as a clove

effects.note: This is the actual form most of the garlic blood pressure trials used — standardized dried garlic powder, at doses (600-1200mg) close to what a well-seasoned dish delivers. See garlic for the full evidence trail. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
